source.method: Every available facility's candidates re-derived from the snapshot after the 2026-10-12 topology review: each ramp is the link chain from a surface end to the carriageway it merges into (entrances) or leaves (exits), parking-area ramps and closed ramps excluded. A ramp binds the interchange its OSM way name or its non-junction motorway_junction node names; an unnamed ramp binds the nearest facility offering that role on a route the ramp carries. At a route's own end the terminal carriageway edge is the toll point. Ramps of other roads (Tomei, Tohoku, Joban, Daisan-Keihin, Yokohama-Yokosuka links) bind no Shuto facility. Every candidate the builder measured keeps its distance; re-pointed ones are measured to their edge.
source.finding: The builder bound every edge of the facility's route within 750 m, and 613 of 1,376 candidates sat more than 200 m away: facilities started or ended on a neighbour's ramp (一ツ橋 on 西神田's, 鈴ヶ森 on 勝島's, 宝町 and 京橋 on the KK branch now called 東銀座), on the opposite direction's ramp, on parking-area return ramps (平和島 on 平和島PA's), on bare carriageway segments (大黒ふ頭 on the Bayshore through lanes, 千鳥町, 三溪園), or on links of the connecting expressways. After this review every ramp binds at most one interchange name.
source.fare_check: Checked against the operator's 2026-10 fare and distance table (https://www.shutoko.jp/ss/2026ryoukin-kaitei/gallery/ryoukin-kaitei_toll_rates.pdf), which is not distributed here; see the review notes in docs/product/network-snapshot.md.
source.not_resolved: Directions the operator lists but the snapshot has no ramp for stay unbound rather than borrowing a neighbour's: 新都心西 下り entrance, 横浜港北 (横浜北線) 下り entrance and 上り exit, and 八潮 下り exit (unbound 2026-10-18: its only link rejoins the carriageway).
